Hi Karthik,

We received Invoice_202506_omniapps.pdf earlier today and there are two things that don't line up for us:

1) A ~1.2M token overage charge on the hosted API line — we were expecting a small spike but nothing on this scale.
2) VAT was applied to our US entity (OmniApps LLC). For June traffic the EU legal entity (OmniApps Europe GmbH) should have been the billable party and the reverse-charge should apply — we provided the EU VAT number when we set up the account.

Can you help explain the token surge (we think it might be related to a parallel ingest job we ran the week of Jun 23) and confirm whether you can reissue the invoice with the correct VAT treatment? We can share telemetry if it helps. We've attached the PDF we received.

Thanks,
Oliver

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for the sample and the VAT details — that helped. I pulled the June 23–25 ingestion window and matched the request IDs you provided. Summary below: 

- Root cause: A backfill job used a legacy API key tied to your staging project. Our attribution rules treat keys as the primary owner for metering; because that key was not tagged to your EU production tenant, the tokens were attributed to OmniApps LLC (US) in our billing pipeline.
- Token count: The ingest produced ~1.18M additional tokens during the 3-day window; we've attached a short meter sample export.
- VAT: We confirm that the account had the EU VAT ID on file but it was not linked to the specific API key/tenant that generated the traffic. For correct reverse-charge treatment we need the invoice entity to be OmniApps Europe GmbH; we can reissue the invoice once the entity mapping is corrected.

Proposed remediation:
1) We will issue a provisional credit of 60% of the overage while we run a full audit (expected 5 business days).
2) We'll re-run attribution after you approve us linking the legacy key to OmniApps Europe GmbH. If the audit shows full misattribution, we'll issue a final credit for the remainder.
3) We'll reissue Invoice_202506 with reverse-charge (VAT net zero) once the mapping change is done.

I've attached the meter sample (metering_sample_202507.csv) and a billing trace we exported. Can you confirm you approve the provisional credit and the key mapping change? Once you confirm we'll mark the invoice as pending and block collection notices.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: metering_sample_202507.csv (csv)]
